name: add_code_reference
description: Add a persistent reference to Cheat Engine's code-dissection data.

isString.description: For memory references, record the target as a string.

name: add_memory_record
description: Add a typed top-level memory record to the Cheat Engine address list.

address.description: Cheat Engine address expression, such as game.exe+10.

name: add_structure_element
description: Append one Structure Dissect element with validated primitive fields.

offset.description: Byte offset from the structure base.

byteSize.description: Optional byte size for strings or byte arrays (0-1048576).

childClassName.description: Optional child class-name hint (up to 256 characters).

name: allocate_memory
description: Allocate target memory owned by a named Client lease.

name: analyze_code_range
description: Run Cheat Engine's code dissector on one bounded target-memory range.

address.description: Range base address or symbol expression.

name: aob_scan
description: Run a bounded AOB scan using CheatEngine.Client.

moduleName.description: Optional module name that bounds the scan.

startAddress.description: Optional inclusive first match address; requires endAddress.

endAddress.description: Optional inclusive last match address; requires startAddress.

name: aob_scan_unique
description: Find at most one AOB match; truncated results are not proof of uniqueness.

moduleName.description: Optional module name that bounds the scan.

name: assemble
description: Assemble one target instruction into bytes through the Client instruction capability.

instruction.description: Assembly source for exactly one instruction.

address.description: Target origin as hexadecimal; required for relative operands.

name: auto_assemble
description: Apply an Auto Assembler patch and retain its Client lease, or release a previously returned patch ID.

script.description: Complete Auto Assembler source, required when applying a patch.

disableId.description: Patch ID returned by a prior enable call. Supplying it releases that Client-owned patch.

name.description: Optional diagnostic name for a new patch.

name: auto_assemble_check
description: Check an Auto Assembler [ENABLE] section without applying a patch.

name.description: Optional diagnostic name for the script.

name: autoguess_structure
description: Ask Cheat Engine to infer Structure Dissect fields from a bounded target range.

baseAddress.description: Target base address or symbol expression.

name: clear_code_analysis
description: Clear Cheat Engine's current code-dissection data and references.

name: compare_memory
description: Compare two bounded memory ranges through Cheat Engine Lua.

name: convert_string
description: Convert text with a managed MD5 digest or explicit UTF-8 and ANSI byte round trips.

name: copy_memory
description: Copy a bounded memory range using Cheat Engine's target or local copy route.

destinationAddress.description: Destination address expression or number. Allocate a Client-owned destination first when needed.

name: create_process
description: Launch and open a process through Cheat Engine. This starts an external executable.

breakOnEntryPoint.description: Break at entry point; requires debug=true.

name: create_structure
description: Create a persistent global Structure Dissect definition. Delete it explicitly with delete_structure.

isInternal.description: Hide the definition from normal Structure Dissect selection.

name: dbk_control_registers
description: Read copied CR0, CR3, and CR4 values through DBK.

name: dbk_physical_address
description: Resolve a target virtual address to its physical address through DBK.

address.description: Target virtual address expression or number.

name: dbk_status
description: Report whether DBK is already initialized; this query does not initialize it.

name: dbvm_cr4
description: Read DBVM's real CR4 value.

name: dbvm_initialize
description: Initialize DBVM. Offloading the operating system is advanced and can destabilize the host.

offloadOperatingSystem.description: Offload the operating system when possible.

reason.description: Short diagnostic reason, up to 256 characters.

name: dbvm_read_physical
description: Read a bounded physical-memory range through DBVM.

name: dbvm_status
description: Report whether DBVM is already initialized; this query does not initialize it.

name: dbvm_watch
description: Capture a DBVM watch for up to five seconds and disable it before returning up to 1024 copied events.

options.description: DBVM options bit field, bits 0-3 only.

durationMilliseconds.description: Capture duration (1-5000 milliseconds). Blocks Cheat Engine during capture.

name: dbvm_watch_log
description: Retrieve a bounded copied DBVM watch log.

name: dbvm_watch_stop
description: Disable a DBVM watch by identifier.

name: dbvm_write_physical
description: Write a bounded hexadecimal byte sequence to physical memory through DBVM.

name: debugger_add_breakpoint
description: Create an execute, access, or write breakpoint. It persists until removed or debugger detachment.

size.description: Watch size for access or write: 1, 2, 4, or 8.

name: debugger_break_thread
description: Request that Cheat Engine break a target thread; stopping can be asynchronous.

name: debugger_breakpoints
description: Return a bounded copied list of breakpoint addresses.

name: debugger_context
description: Read copied current registers; the debugger must be broken for meaningful values.

name: debugger_continue
description: Continue, step into, or step over from the current broken context.

name: debugger_detach
description: Unpause and detach the debugger while preserving the current target selection.

name: debugger_ignore_thread
description: Add or remove a target thread from Cheat Engine's breakpoint-ignore list.

name: debugger_poll_capture
description: Read buffered breakpoint hits in FIFO order without waiting; clear removes only the returned hits.

clear.description: Remove the returned hits from the buffer.

name: debugger_poll_step_trace
description: Copy collected trace contexts without waiting or consuming them.

name: debugger_remove_breakpoint
description: Remove the breakpoint containing the supplied address.

name: debugger_set_register
description: Set one general-purpose register in the currently broken debugger context, then write the context back before continuation.

register.description: Register name: EAX through EIP, RAX through R15, RIP, RSP, RBP, or EFLAGS.

name: debugger_start
description: Attach the selected debugger interface. A repeated request is idempotent. Interface changes require explicit detach; targets previously using VEH must restart before reattachment.

name: debugger_start_capture
description: Find instructions accessing or writing an address using a pollable breakpoint capture. Hits contain trap IP, thread ID and registers. Automatically expires; poll results within 30 seconds of expiry.

maximumHits.description: Maximum buffered hits, 1-1024; excess hits are counted as dropped.

name: debugger_start_step_trace
description: Break at an address and single-step one thread for a bounded number of contexts, then leave it stopped. Requires no existing breakpoints or global breakpoint hook. Results expire 30 seconds after completion or timeout.

maximumSteps.description: Maximum contexts including the entry instruction, 1-256.

name: debugger_status
description: Read copied debugger state and active interface.

name: debugger_stop_capture
description: Remove the owned capture breakpoint, timer, and results. Cleanup failures retain the ID for retry.

name: debugger_stop_step_trace
description: Remove the owned trace breakpoint, hook, timer and results. Does not resume a stopped thread; cleanup failures retain the ID for retry.

name: delete_code_reference
description: Remove one source-to-destination code reference.

name: delete_memory_record
description: Delete one memory record by Client-issued record ID.

name: delete_pointer_map
description: Delete an MCP pointer snapshot. Existing copied scan paths remain usable.

name: delete_structure
description: Remove a persistent global Structure Dissect definition by name.

name: disassemble
description: Disassemble one instruction or obtain its exact length at a target address.

name: disassemble_bytes
description: Disassemble a bounded hexadecimal byte sequence without reading target memory.

hexadecimalBytes.description: Hexadecimal bytes, up to 1 MiB of text.

address.description: Optional target origin expression for relative operands.

name: disassemble_range
description: Disassemble a bounded sequence of target instructions using the Client's typed assembly API.

name: dump_memory
description: Write a bounded target-memory range to an explicit file through a temporary Cheat Engine memory stream.

name: enum_memory_regions
description: Copy a bounded target memory-region map.

name: enum_module_sections
description: Copy a bounded section list for one target module through CheatEngine.Client.

name: enum_modules
description: Copy a bounded module list from the selected target.

name: enum_registered_symbols
description: List symbols currently owned by this MCP server.

name: execute_local_code
description: Execute a one-parameter stdcall function inside Cheat Engine and return its copied result.

address.description: Cheat Engine local function address expression or number.

name: execute_lua
description: Execute trusted Lua through the Client capability, enabled by default. Prefer typed MCP tools whenever possible.

chunkName.description: Optional non-empty chunk name for Lua diagnostics.

name: execute_remote_code
description: Execute a one-parameter stdcall function in the selected target and return its copied result.

address.description: Target function address expression or number.

timeoutMilliseconds.description: Timeout in milliseconds, 1 through 300000. The call waits for completion within the supplied timeout.

name: fill_structure_from_dotnet
description: Fill an existing Structure Dissect definition using the layout of a target .NET object.

changeName.description: Rename the structure to the .NET class name.

name: find_memory_records_by_description
description: Find up to 1024 current address-list records matching an exact description.

description.description: Exact record description, up to 256 characters.

name: free_memory
description: Release a named target-memory allocation lease.

name.description: The allocation name returned by allocate_memory.

name: full_access_memory
description: Make a bounded target range writable and executable through Cheat Engine Lua.

size.description: Positive range size in bytes, up to 1048576.

name: generate_api_hook_script
description: Generate a Cheat Engine Auto Assembler API-hook script without applying it.

newCallAddress.description: Optional symbol for the new call address.

name: generate_pointer_map
description: Capture a bounded pointer snapshot with Client memory APIs. Maps live until deleted or plugin disable; they are not CE .scandata files. Inspect incomplete before relying on absence.

startAddress.description: Optional first address expression to capture; requires endAddress.

endAddress.description: Optional inclusive last address expression; requires startAddress.

maximumBytes.description: Maximum attempted readable bytes, 1-67108864; default 16 MiB.

alignment.description: Pointer storage alignment: 1, 2, 4, or 8. Four also finds 4-aligned x64 pointers.

name: get_address_list
description: Copy the current top-level Cheat Engine address list.

maximumRecords.description: Maximum records to materialize. The request fails if the table exceeds this bound.

name: get_code_references
description: Read copied references to an address from Cheat Engine's current code dissector data.

name: get_comment
description: Read the persistent user-defined Memory View comment at a target address.

name: get_current_process
description: Get the process currently selected in Cheat Engine.

name: get_function_range
description: Return Cheat Engine's estimated function boundaries for a target address.

name: get_memory_protection
description: Read the target memory protection flags reported by Cheat Engine Lua.

name: get_memory_record_details
description: Read pointer offsets and script text for one current Cheat Engine memory-record ID.

name: get_memory_region
description: Get copied metadata for the region containing an address.

address.description: A hexadecimal address or Cheat Engine address expression.

name: get_memory_scan_results
description: Read a bounded page from main's visible CE found list, including manual scans, or an independent Client session. Main must have completed; unknown-initial baselines need a next scan first.

scannerName.description: main (default) for the visible CE scan tab, or an existing independent scanner name.

name: get_memory_scan_status
description: Get main's live UI scan state or an independent session's state. Poll main until ResultsReady or BaselineReady before reading or narrowing; Scanning is still in progress.

scannerName.description: main (default) for the visible CE scan tab, or an existing independent scanner name.

name: get_module_preference
description: Get Cheat Engine's symbol lookup module-precedence list, capped at 1024 entries.

name: get_name_from_address
description: Resolve the best Cheat Engine name for an address.

address.description: A hexadecimal address or Cheat Engine address expression.

name: get_opened_file_size
description: Get the size of the currently opened file-as-process target.

name: get_plugin_version
description: Get the loaded plugin version and assembly path.

name: get_pointer_scan_results
description: Page stored pointer chains. Offsets are in dereference order; CE's address-list offset order is reversed.

name: get_pointer_size
description: Get Cheat Engine's configured target pointer size.

name: get_previous_opcodes
description: Return a bounded predecessor-instruction walk before one target address.

name: get_process_list
description: List a bounded set of local processes.

name: get_process_state
description: Get the currently opened target process ID, pause state, and age.

name: get_referenced_functions
description: List bounded function addresses referenced by the current code dissector data.

name: get_referenced_strings
description: Read a bounded copied list of strings referenced by current code dissector data.

name: get_runtime_info
description: Read the active Client epoch, host version and capability evidence before using optional features.

name: get_selected_memory_record
description: Read the currently selected Cheat Engine address-list record with pointer-offset details.

name: get_speedhack_speed
description: Get Cheat Engine's last configured speedhack speed.

name: get_structure
description: Get one global or internal Structure Dissect definition by its case-sensitive name.

name: get_structure_element_value
description: Read one Structure Dissect element value from a target base address.

baseAddress.description: Target base address or symbol expression.

name: get_structure_elements
description: Get PDB-backed structure elements by name, capped at 4096 entries.

name: get_symbol_info
description: Get copied metadata for one Cheat Engine symbol expression.

name: get_symbols_loading_state
description: Get whether Cheat Engine reports all symbols loaded.

name: get_thread_list
description: List target thread IDs reported by Cheat Engine, capped at 4096 entries.

name: hash_memory
description: Compute Cheat Engine's MD5 hash for a bounded target memory range.

name: inject_dotnet_library
description: Inject a managed assembly and invoke its static entry point in the selected target.

name: inject_library
description: Inject a native DLL or library into the selected target. Cheat Engine must report true for success.

fileName.description: Absolute library path, up to 32767 characters.

skipSymbolReloadWait.description: Skip symbol reload wait after injection.

name: instance_list
title: List Cheat Engine instances
description: Lists the local Cheat Engine instances whose MCP plugin is enabled and verified. Call it first: every other tool needs one returned instanceId, and there is no default instance. Names may repeat; route by instanceId. An instanceId changes whenever the plugin is enabled again or CE restarts.

instances.description: The instances whose backend confirmed its registry identity, ordered by name.

instanceId.description: The id to pass as instanceId to every other tool; new on every plugin enable.

name.description: The display name; names may repeat across instances.

processId.description: The Cheat Engine process id, not the target's.

pluginVersion.description: The plugin version of this activation.

discoveryIncomplete.description: True when discovery stopped at its 10 s budget; call instance_list again before concluding that an instance is missing.

name: is_jump_destination
description: Check whether an address is a jump destination within a bounded code range.

range.description: Containing function or code-range size in bytes (1-1048576).

name: list_memory_scanners
description: List main (the currently visible CE scan tab) and up to 32 independent Client scan sessions in this instance. Independent scanner names do not refer to CE UI tabs.

name: list_pointer_maps
description: List bounded MCP-owned snapshots and their capture completeness.

name: list_structures
description: List up to 1024 global Cheat Engine Structure Dissect definitions.

name: load_cheat_table
description: Load a trusted absolute Cheat Engine table path. The Client enforces configured table roots.

filename.description: Absolute .CT or .CETRAINER path under a configured trusted table root.

merge.description: Merge into the current table instead of replacing it.

name: load_new_symbols
description: Ask Cheat Engine to scan for loaded modules and add their symbols.

name: lookup_rtti_class_name
description: Resolve a likely RTTI class name for a target address, returning found=false when unavailable.

name: memory_scan
description: Start a value scan. The default main scanner uses CE's visible scan tab and UI options; poll its status for completion. Other names create independent Client sessions without changing the UI. Reset explicitly before another first scan.

scannerName.description: main (default) for the visible CE scan tab, or a unique case-sensitive name for an independent session (up to 32). The name main is reserved.

valueType.description: byte, int16, int32 (default), int64, float, double, string, wstring, or bytes.

value.description: Value for exact, between, greater, or less comparisons; omit for unknown initial value.

comparison.description: exact, unknown, between, greater, or less.

upperValue.description: Inclusive upper value for a between comparison.

name: next_memory_scan
description: Narrow main's visible CE scan (including a manually started scan), or a named independent Client scan. Poll main's status until completion.

scannerName.description: main (default) for the visible CE scan tab, or an existing independent scanner name.

value.description: Value for exact, between, greater, less, increasedBy, or decreasedBy comparisons; omit for state comparisons.

comparison.description: exact, between, greater, less, increased, decreased, increasedBy, decreasedBy, changed, or unchanged.

upperValue.description: Inclusive upper value for a between comparison.

name: open_file_as_process
description: Open a file through Cheat Engine's process-like memory interface.

startAddress.description: Optional base address expression or number.

name: open_process
description: Attach Cheat Engine to a process ID or exact process name.

process.description: A positive process ID or an exact process name.

name: pause_process
description: Pause the currently opened Cheat Engine target process.

name: pointer_scan
description: Find pointer chains in a captured map using nonnegative offsets. Results and traversal are bounded; module-relative roots support later rebasing.

targetAddress.description: Hexadecimal destination address in the snapshot, with optional 0x prefix.

maximumOffset.description: Largest nonnegative offset at each hop, 0-1048576.

moduleRootsOnly.description: Only return roots inside known modules.

name: read_memory
description: Read typed target memory through CheatEngine.Client.

address.description: A hexadecimal address or Cheat Engine address expression.

dataType.description: bytes, byte, int16, int32, int64, float, double, or string.

byteCount.description: Required byte count for bytes reads.

maximumLength.description: Required maximum length for string reads.

wideChar.description: Read or write UTF-16 strings instead of UTF-8.

name: read_pointer_chain
description: Resolve a bounded pointer chain using the target pointer width.

offsets.description: One to 64 signed offsets, applied after each dereference.

name: register_symbol
description: Register a Client-owned target symbol. The server releases it on disable.

name.description: Session-wide symbol name. Use a distinctive name to avoid collisions.

doNotSave.description: Omit the symbol when Cheat Engine saves a table.

name: reinitialize_dotnet_symbols
description: Reinitialize the .NET symbol list for an optional module.

module.description: Optional module name, up to 256 characters.

name: reinitialize_symbols
description: Reinitialize Cheat Engine's symbol handler.

name: release_target_resources
description: Release owned scans, symbols, allocations and patches in reverse creation order before switching processes. Stops at the first incomplete release.

name: remove_structure_element
description: Remove one Structure Dissect element by zero-based index.

name: rescan_pointer_scan
description: Filter existing paths against a new map or live Client pointer-chain reads. Module roots rebase; absolute roots remain absolute. Unresolved paths are retained and counted; interrupted scans keep original results.

targetAddress.description: New hexadecimal destination address, with optional 0x prefix.

mapName.description: New snapshot name, or omit to read the currently selected process.

name: reset_memory_scan
description: Reset main through CE's New Scan action (clearing visible results), or release one independent Client session. Refuses to reset a running UI scan; cancel it in CE first.

scannerName.description: main (default) for the visible CE scan tab, or the independent scanner name to release.

name: reset_pointer_scan
description: Release an MCP-owned pointer result list.

name: resolve_address
description: Resolve a target-process symbol expression, such as game.exe+10.

shallow.description: Use Cheat Engine shallow symbol resolution.

name: resume_process
description: Resume the currently opened Cheat Engine target process.

name: save_cheat_table
description: Save the current table to a trusted absolute Cheat Engine table path.

filename.description: Absolute destination path under a configured trusted table root.

name: save_opened_file
description: Save the open file-as-process target, optionally to an explicit filename.

filename.description: Optional destination filename, up to 4096 characters.

name: select_memory_record
description: Select one current Cheat Engine address-list record by ID.

name: set_comment
description: Set a persistent user-defined Memory View comment at a target address.

name: set_memory_protection
description: Set target range read, write, and execute protection through Cheat Engine Lua.

size.description: Positive range size in bytes, up to 1048576.

name: set_memory_record_active
description: Activate or deactivate one memory record by Client-issued record ID.

name: set_memory_record_offsets
description: Replace a memory record's pointer offsets. Offsets are Cheat Engine internal order, index zero nearest the final value.

offsets.description: Pointer offsets in Cheat Engine internal order, up to 128 entries.

name: set_memory_record_script
description: Set a bounded Auto Assembler script on a memory record. The record persists it in the cheat table.

script.description: Auto Assembler script text, up to 1 MiB.

name: set_module_preference
description: Put one extensionless module name first in Cheat Engine symbol lookup precedence.

module.description: Extensionless module name, up to 256 characters.

name: set_pointer_size
description: Set Cheat Engine's configured target pointer size to 4 or 8 bytes.

name: set_speedhack_speed
description: Enable Cheat Engine speedhack and set a finite positive target speed.

name: set_structure_element_value
description: Write a value interpreted by a Structure Dissect element into the selected target.

baseAddress.description: Target structure base address or symbol.

value.description: Value in Cheat Engine's format for the element type.

name: unregister_symbol
description: Release a symbol that this MCP server registered in the current activation.

name: update_memory_record
description: Update one memory record by Client-issued record ID.

id.description: Client-issued memory-record ID from get_address_list or add_memory_record.

variableType.description: Replacement Cheat Engine variable type, if any.

name: update_structure_element
description: Change selected fields of one Structure Dissect element by zero-based index.

offset.description: Replacement offset, or null to retain it.

name.description: Replacement element name, or null to retain it.

variableType.description: Replacement variable-type integer, or null to retain it.

byteSize.description: Replacement byte size (0-1048576), or null to retain it.

name: wait_for_symbols
description: Wait for one Cheat Engine symbol-loading stage.

name: write_memory
description: Write typed target memory through CheatEngine.Client.

address.description: A hexadecimal address or Cheat Engine address expression.

dataType.description: bytes, byte, int16, int32, int64, float, double, or string.

value.description: The value formatted for the selected data type.

maximumLength.description: Explicit maximum encoded length for string writes.

wideChar.description: Read or write UTF-16 strings instead of UTF-8.
